name: Southern Gold Road
summary: Caravans and travelers crowd the Southern Gold Road as it runs through the Barrens toward the Great Lift. Trade links the central plains with distant reaches of Kalimdor.

sections.title: Artery of the South
sections.body: At the stone bridge between the northern and southern Barrens, the Southern Gold Road turns south toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles. Like the northern stretch, simply called the Gold Road, it takes its name from the lucrative merchant caravans that travel its length. Quilboar tribes and prowling predators harass those who use it, yet the road remains one of the continent’s busiest long-distance routes. Goods pass along it between remote outposts and ports.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Distant Lands
sections.body: Horde couriers and patrols share the Southern Gold Road with merchants and explorers bound for distant lands. Travelers journey between Gadgetzan in the southern deserts of Tanaris, Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore, and Nighthaven, among the sacred groves of Moonglade. For those crossing Kalimdor’s interior on foot, surviving the journey down this sun-baked road is a grueling rite of passage.

faq.q: Where does the Southern Gold Road start and end?
faq.answer: The Southern Gold Road begins at the bridge between the northern and southern Barrens and runs south to the Great Lift at the edge of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why is it called the Gold Road?
faq.answer: The road takes its name from the valuable trade caravans that carry precious goods, ore, and coin across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Gold Road and the Southern Gold Road?
aliases: gold road vs southern gold road
faq.answer: The bridge between the two halves of the Barrens divides the routes: north of it is the Gold Road, while the stretch south to the Great Lift is the Southern Gold Road.

faq.q: Who travels along this stretch of road?
faq.answer: Horde couriers and patrols use the road, as do merchants and explorers traveling between Gadgetzan to the south and Darkshore and Moonglade to the north.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you rely on the Southern Gold Road to carry supplies between the Barrens’ central crossway and the southern outposts near Thousand Needles.
